mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has reached an extreme low point of -87.1% from baseline. A natural floor effect suggests that further significant declines are unlikely, leading to a slight rebound or stabilization at a less negative level over the next four weeks as some essential retail activity resumes.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days, indicating no rebound or stabilization.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains consistently high, indicating continued adherence to stay-at-home behaviors, it will directly suppress any recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks, keeping it at depressed levels.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 32% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 32% for two consecutive weeks, but RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous week-on-week increase in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates a cautious return to work and associated commuting patterns. This combined increase will drive a modest recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks as more people are out and about.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES increases week-on-week AND TRANSIT increases week-on-week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both increase week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC continues to decline or remains flat over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The current pattern of extremely low RETAIL_REC, high RESIDENTIAL, and low TRANSIT mobility signifies a persistent regime of tight government restrictions. As long as this policy regime holds, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Despite the persistence of current mobility patterns (low RETAIL_REC, high RESIDENTIAL, low TRANSIT), RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant further decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, falling below -75% week-on-week, would signal a severe disruption to even essential services, indicating a worsening crisis that would further depress RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -75% week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC does not decrease further over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained low levels of PARKS mobility, consistently below -70% from baseline, reflect a pervasive public caution and avoidance of non-essential outdoor activities. This underlying behavioral pattern will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility remains consistently below -70%, but RETAIL_REC significantly increases over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PARKS mobility and a decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a shift in public behavior towards cautiously venturing out of homes. This combined trend will lead to a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases week-on-week AND RESIDENTIAL decreases week-on-week
failure_condition: PARKS increases week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL decreases week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The current snapshot shows all mobility categories (except RESIDENTIAL) at extremely low levels, indicating a near-complete shutdown of normal economic and social activity. If this 'complete shutdown' regime persists, RETAIL_REC will remain at its current depressed levels over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Despite all specified proxies remaining at current extreme levels, RETAIL_REC shows a significant positive change over the next 28 days.
